init_hook: echo '  DB:      postgres://localhost:5432/themis  (docker container, must be running)'
echo '  NIM LLM: http://localhost:8000             (docker container, must be running)'
echo '  migrate-up      apply pending DB migrations'
echo '  migrate-down    roll back last migration'
echo '  migrate-create  create a new migration file (pass name as first arg)'
echo '  sqlc            regenerate Go query code from SQL'
echo '  generate        migrate-up + sqlc in one step'
echo '  build-backend   compile backend to bin/api'
echo '  build-crawler   compile data crawler to bin/crawler'
echo '  run-backend     run the backend API server'
echo '  run-crawler     run the data crawler'
